name: Frontenac National Park
policyReason: Leashed dogs are allowed in parts of the park, never in the Sud sector and not in Saint-Daniel in winter.
summary: Leashed dogs are allowed in parts of the park, never in the Sud sector and not in Saint-Daniel in winter.

excerpts.quote: Notez que les chiens sont interdits en tout temps au secteur Sud et qu'ils ne sont pas admis au secteur Saint-Daniel en période hivernale, soit du 1er novembre au 30 avril.
dogs are generally allowed on the summer trails from early May to late October.

dogRules.text: No dogs in the Sud sector at any time; none in Saint-Daniel from November 1 to April 30.
Dogs allowed at Baie-des-Sables and Rivière-aux-Bluets campgrounds, not at Baie-aux-Rats-Musqués.
Beach access no. 4 is open to dogs; leashed dogs allowed at the boat ramp.
